description: Prospecting app for finding viable areas to land and set up a mining operation on the moon.
summary:
An app created for people that need to prospect the moon surface for viable landing spots, the app is centered around finding viable flat/open areas nearby desired resources.
Once a suitable area is found for landing, habitation, factory/operations, the app will create a viable path of least resistance regarding height difference between the base area and each resource.
The app uses a scoring system based on slope values, free open area and path distance to resources to provide the best placements for the users specific needs.
